ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The chart on the elbow is kept in the green folder. ... The chart on the stomach is kept in the blue folder. ... The chart on the knee is kept in the cyan folder. ... Which colour is the folder that holds the chart on the body part that bends the leg?" -> answer org cyan; the alt prompt asks about the stomach (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: blue (answer of bridge alt's statement), green (answer at the same statement slot), pink (the alt prompt's own answer), cyan (answer org kept).
